VBO:0200305.summary: Cuddly and affectionate, Cavachi Stanley gives a personal glimpse of this Cavalier King Charles Spaniel–Chihuahua cross. His veterinary-nurse keeper says he accompanies her to work each day and loves returning stuffed toys for another throw. He learned basic commands readily, although coming when called could remain his own decision. These are observations of one dog.
VBO:0200305.shortDescription: A Cavalier–Chihuahua cross; Stanley’s keeper describes affection, stuffed-toy retrieving and an independent streak at recall.
